import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
old="/srv/lowcost-europa";new="/srv/projects/lowcost-europa"
targets=[
"/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service",
"/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service",
"/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.service",
"/etc/nginx/sites-available/lowcost-europa-temp",
"/usr/local/sbin/lowcost-europa-backup",
"/usr/local/sbin/lowcost-europa-offsite-backup",
"/usr/local/sbin/lowcost-europa-offsite-backup-health",
"/usr/local/sbin/project-secrets-offsite-backup"]
result={"files":{},"project_root_valid":Path(new).is_dir() and not Path(new).is_symlink(),"archives_in_project":(Path(new)/"archive").is_dir()}
for s in targets:
 p=Path(s)
 try:
  b=p.read_bytes();st=p.lstat()
  result["files"][s]={"regular":p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(),"mode":oct(st.st_mode&0o777),"uid":st.st_uid,"gid":st.st_gid,"size":len(b),"root_refs":b.count(old.encode()),"new_root_refs":b.count(new.encode()),"backup_refs":b.count(b"/var/backups/lowcost-europa"),"data_refs":b.count(b"/var/lib/lowcost-europa"),"private_refs":b.count(b"/root/project-secrets/lowcost-europa")}
 except OSError as e:result["files"][s]={"error":type(e).__name__}
result["nginx_ok"]=subprocess.run(["nginx","-t"],capture_output=True,timeout=8).returncode==0
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
